claims.claim: Firefly descent expands network width or depth by searching a functional neighborhood around the current network using a Taylor-based greedy selection rule.
claims.notes: Derived from the paper's description of the Firefly descent mechanism.

initialization_strategy: Start from an initial base network
mechanistic_notes: The method approximates the loss change in a functional neighborhood using a first-order Taylor expansion to guide growth decisions.
summary: Firefly Neural Architecture Descent grows networks by expanding width or depth via a Taylor-based greedy search of the functional neighborhood.
website_alignment_notes: Mechanistic decomposition focuses on the operational rule (Taylor-based greedy search) rather than high-level marketing claims.
